subject.title: fix(imessage): keep fast progress out of chat

question: Should iMessage intentionally suppress automatic fast-mode notices when native typing is unavailable rather than write those internal lifecycle notices into durable chat history?
rationale: The patch implements a channel-specific presentation policy; its proof supports the behavior, but the protected maintainer state requires an explicit owner decision before merge.

options.title: Approve transient-only iMessage progress
options.body: Accept the existing proposal that fast-mode lifecycle notices are internal progress and should not persist in iMessage chat, then refresh the branch and merge.

options.title: Require a durable fallback
options.body: Keep a visible fallback when typing is unavailable, which would require a different implementation and user-facing policy rationale.

recommendation.title: Approve transient-only iMessage progress
recommendation.body: Accept the existing proposal that fast-mode lifecycle notices are internal progress and should not persist in iMessage chat, then refresh the branch and merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR explicitly routes review to this person; feature-history ownership could not be established from the read-only command environment.
